method: null / negative control - composition-preserving shuffles and non-RT decoys scored by whichever method is under test
metric: fraction of decoys receiving PRESENT_HIGH_CONF on any region
failure_consequence: any method exceeding 1 percent is withdrawn before its other numbers are read

method: column-profile / PSSM baseline over the conserved-position set, ungapped local scan
derivation_data: ALIGN_000044 RT-domain columns and the 81-position conserved set only
parameter_budget: at most 12 configurations, enumerated before execution
secondary_estimands: Q02 ordered-architecture rate; Q10 stability IoU
metric: median absolute residue offset; ordered fraction; median IoU
failure_consequence: recorded as a result; a baseline that fails is informative, not hidden

method: profile HMM built on the ALIGN_000044 RT-domain alignment as submitted, with per-column posterior giving core-membership
derivation_data: ALIGN_000044 as submitted - no reseeding, no iterative expansion, no prior model
tunable_parameters: architecture prior; entropy weighting; domain E-value and per-column posterior thresholds
parameter_budget: at most 12 configurations, enumerated before execution

method: frozen residue-level representation plus a linear decoder over conserved-column membership - RUN ONLY IF a pinned local protein LM already exists and a measured pilot fits the budget
derivation_data: the 66 derivation proteins' column labels only; the representation model is frozen and never fine-tuned
failure_consequence: inability to run is recorded, not fatal. Sophistication is not a selection criterion

method: all methods are scored on the same arms, with the same splits, the same estimands and the same metrics
failure_consequence: a comparison across different quantities is not a comparison

method: no method sees A2, A3 or A4 during derivation, development or threshold selection
rule R-DYAD: no method may use the catalytic motif in its derivation, features, scoring or thresholds
failure_consequence: a method that uses the motif forfeits Q03 and Q15, which are the only identifiable landmark and calibration estimands in the track

method: the winner is the SIMPLEST method that meets the acceptance criteria and transfers most stably, not the highest-scoring one
failure_consequence: if M1 meets the criteria, M2 and M3 are reported as comparators and M1 is frozen

method: uncertainty on every comparison is clustered by derivation-identity stratum and by family, never computed as if sequences were independent draws
no region-specific threshold. One preregistered rule applies to every region, including region 1 / RT1
failure_consequence: failed-review repair 9: RT1 may not be rescued by tuning
